## What this changes

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint and geometry tests).
- [ ] If the geometry changed: the SolidCraft master (`cad/aess_master.sc`) was updated to match, and the fixture volumes in `test/core.test.js` were re-measured.
- [ ] If the standard changed: `docs/STANDARD.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` were updated, and the change is called out as breaking when old parts no longer fit.
- [ ] If a printed part was involved: printer, material and result are noted below.
